name: Singles shadow baseline (ratings only)
signal_definition: Walk-forward opponent-aware team ratings, K=4 game prior, no personnel term, sigma floor from 2015-2025 residuals. Priced from the side distribution.
staking_definition: Flat 1 unit, -110 assumed where no recorded price, real price where recorded; singles only, no live staking during escrow.
gates: G1 n>=200; G2 cluster-bootstrap Brier skill > 0 vs devigged market; G3 BH q=0.10; G4 no refit on holdout; G5 side balance 35-65%; G6 price basis >= 50% real prices
confirm_if: Skill score lower bound > 0 on >= 200 graded singles AND mean CLV > 0 with its CI above 0
refute_if: Brier skill lower bound <= 0 on 200 graded singles OR side share outside 35-65% for 4 consecutive weeks
registration_note: the commit carrying the frozen text; re-run this script after each merge that changes prereg.csv

name: Personnel-surprise singles
signal_definition: PR-01 plus beta x availability deficit gap, beta frozen from 2016-2024 only, published as a surprise delta rather than a level.
gates: Same six gates plus G7 ablation delta must beat PR-01 on the same games with a CI excluding zero
confirm_if: Delta Brier vs PR-01 has a lower bound above 0 on >= 200 games
refute_if: Delta lower bound <= 0 after 200 games or the beta CI from history crosses 0
registration_note: the commit carrying the frozen text; re-run this script after each merge that changes prereg.csv

name: Total T1 scoring-rate singles
signal_definition: Expected points from the same ratings (own rate plus opponent concession) with shrinkage; no venue term
confirm_if: Skill > 0 vs market and CLV CI above 0

name: Total T2 context singles
signal_definition: League-mean total plus measured roof/surface and rest-differential adjustments only; no scoring-rate term
gates: Same six gates plus G8 head-to-head vs PR-03 with a CI excluding zero on the paired MAE
confirm_if: Paired MAE difference favours T2 with CI above 0
refute_if: Paired difference CI contains 0 after 200 games

name: Game parlay (side plus total same game)
signal_definition: Both legs from PR-01 and PR-03 on one fixture

gates: Joint-evidence gate G9: a directly validated joint probability for the two legs plus the operator void and push rules
confirm_if: Both hold for >= 100 games with the joint term measured
refute_if: Joints differ from the independence assumption by less than the payoff gap (parlay is unpriceable)
